three-ws.note: three.ws hosted MCP server for Grok. No payment, and no tool on this server moves value. Making or rigging a model needs a free three.ws account: Grok Build opens the three.ws sign-in on first connect. Tools: text or image to a textured GLB, a rigged avatar, auto-rigging, catalog search, render checks and job polling. Signing in also adds your three.ws agents and read-only Solana market intel.
